column1: # ZAP baseline rule configuration (TSV, no header) — passed via -c.

# fails the build. Re-triage whenever the relevant code changes.

column3: User Controllable HTML Element Attribute: heuristic fires on htmlspecialchars-escaped attribute values (verified by .semgrep taint rule + AuthTest)
CSP Not Set: only robots.txt/sitemap.xml static files; app pages send strict CSP with nonce
Non-Storable Content: no-store is intentional — pages carry decrypted locations and secrets
CSP fallback heuristic: default-src, object-src, base-uri and frame-ancestors are all defined
Permissions Policy Not Set: static robots.txt/sitemap.xml only
Base64 Disclosure: the per-request CSP nonce is base64 by design
COEP: optional modern header; the OSM iframe embed requires cross-origin resources
Sec-Fetch-Dest: client-controlled request metadata, not an app property
